Remote DAQ and valve control

Arbalest Rocketry · Sep 2026 – Present

Software for a remote data acquisition and control system on the team’s propulsion test stand, so valves can be operated and sensors monitored from a safe distance. I write the Arduino and C++ code that controls the system and interfaces with the hardware.

The system operates seven valves:

  • 2 dump valves
  • 1 LOX fill valve
  • 2 vent valves (ethanol and LOX)
  • 2 run valves

The control hardware is a cabinet built around a LabJack T7 and Automation Direct P1AM modules, with terminal blocks and a DIN-rail power supply.

  • C++
  • Arduino
  • LabJack T7
  • P1AM PLC
  • Valve control
  • Remote operation

Test stand monitoring and control GUI

Arbalest Rocketry · Sep 2026 – Present

A graphical interface for monitoring and controlling the test stand from one screen. It brings sensor data from the LabJack and the PLC together and lets the operator command the valves.

  • Live monitoring of sensors connected to the LabJack and the PLC
  • Remote control of the valves from the interface
  • Safety checks on valve commands before they are sent
  • Emergency override to handle unsafe situations quickly
  • GUI
  • C++
  • Sensor monitoring
  • Safety interlocks
  • Emergency override

LabJack data acquisition software

Arbalest Rocketry · Sep 2026 – Present

C++ software that connects to a LabJack T7 to read and log sensor data and to actuate valves. I also wire the sensors into the LabJack’s analog inputs.

  • Reads sensors on the T7’s analog inputs
  • Logs sensor data for later analysis
  • Actuates valves through the T7’s outputs
  • Feeds the monitoring GUI alongside the PLC data
  • C++
  • LabJack
  • Data logging
  • Sensor interfacing
